evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 4.1 → 6.0 → 13.1 → 19.6 → 26.5 ppm instead of staying at the ~5 ppm purge floor
Heater power stable ~46% with T on setpoint, so the O2 rise is not a thermal/control artifact
Pressure gauge not installed, so tube atmosphere/leak cannot be confirmed by pressure

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) or a leak-check/Ar-flow step-change test to confirm air ingress versus an O2 sensor drift; also post-run film characterization.
